risks_and_deviations: Pending-launch merge is FIFO + grid/workgroup matched (single-GPU sequential apps); correlation-id hardening is a todo-48/49 concern. Runtime-internal dispatches (rocclr copy kernels) never consume the queue.
The kernel-dispatch grid arrives in WORK-ITEMS (ROCm 7.2.3); converted to blocks by dividing through the workgroup size (v0 LaunchRecord grid is in blocks).
Arg bytes are captured from the host-side kernelParams array (byte-exact for user args); hidden_* compiler args are skipped (no kernelParams entry).
Input-buffer capture reads the host source of H2D copies at the API boundary (v0-scope of the Kerncap address-space closure); the full VA-faithful device snapshot policy is todo 46's deliverable.
HSACO blob registered through the fatbin module record (the v0 module-blob record carrying the kernel-name table); todo 46 formalizes the blob kind.
rocprofiler-sdk nix cmake package is broken (self-checks a missing lib subdir) - the tool links librocprofiler-sdk.so by path via ROCPROF_SDK_DEV/ROCPROF_SDK_OUT.
Contexts are created in the tool's initialize callback, not in rocprofiler_configure (client id is assigned only after configure returns; live-caught assert on ROCm 7.2.3).
